name: Stacks Clarity Cloud
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y wget && wget -nv https://github.com/stx-labs/clarinet/releases/latest/download/clarinet-linux-x64-glibc.tar.gz -O clarinet-linux-x64.tar.gz && tar -xf clarinet-linux-x64.tar.gz && chmod +x ./clarinet && sudo mv ./clarinet /usr/local/bin && rm clarinet-linux-x64.tar.gz
